lessons.trigger_condition: V413 could report unknown TCG names from verified local collection outputs but did not persist a new declarative category, leaving the requested discover→WATCH→verify→PROMOTED lifecycle incomplete. V414 adds fail-closed WATCH seeding and adds Godzilla Card Game, Palworld OFFICIAL CARD GAME and Cyberpunk TCG as current watch candidates from fresh official and independent market evidence.
lessons.prevention_rule: For an unregistered TCG, require a safe canonical identity, fresh public-HTTPS official release/promo evidence, fresh public-HTTPS market evidence from a different hostname, and registry capacity before persisting a WATCH row. Seed with activation_score=0, marketplace depth unknown and grading=false. Never auto-promote in the seeding step; later promotion must still satisfy V413 freshness, catalog-depth, score, signal, official and market gates. Never use price direction, profit prediction or user behavior.
validation_required: unknown candidates can be persisted only as WATCH after fresh official HTTPS and fresh independent market HTTPS evidence
same-host official and market evidence is rejected as non-independent
auto-seeded WATCH categories start with activation_score 0 and marketplace_catalog_count null
auto-seeded WATCH categories keep grading disabled
auto-seeding does not auto-promote in the same registry review
later promotion still requires V413 marketplace depth freshness score signal official and market gates
Godzilla Card Game is present as WATCH with verified official and market evidence
Palworld OFFICIAL CARD GAME is present as WATCH and remains below the current catalog-depth promotion gate
Cyberpunk TCG is present as WATCH and remains below the current catalog-depth promotion gate
Pokémon ONE PIECE NARUTO core grading remains enabled
mandatory collection job count remains exactly 8
screen neural remains exactly 17 inputs 12 hidden units and 18 allowlisted outputs
profit guarantee investment-return prediction and market-direction prediction remain false
runtime source auto-rewrite arbitrary commands Git/main writes and verification bypass remain forbidden
physical tablet runtime remains unverified until device-side evidence exists
lessons.safety_boundary: V414 completes declarative category discovery by allowing verified unknown TCGs to enter WATCH. It does not guarantee profit, predict future prices, treat catalog depth as investment advice, auto-enable grading for uncalibrated games, auto-promote a newly seeded unknown, execute arbitrary generated code, rewrite runtime source autonomously, write Git/main, or claim physical Lenovo deployment without device evidence.
